relationships.subject: nipecotic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: Nipecotic acid is considered to be one of the most potent inhibitors of neuronal and glial-aminobutyric acid (GABA) uptake in vitro.

key_findings: An L-serine-tethered nipecotic acid prodrug was synthesized to enhance BBB permeation via carrier-mediated transport.
HPLC data suggest improved BBB penetration and anti-epileptic activity in PTZ mouse model.
